historical_exclusion_reason: Skip on product grounds, not effort. title: Make sure a sandboxed or compromised process never holds a usable API key
contract: iron-proxy: a pinned, signature-verified Go binary run as a local TLS-intercepting proxy with a 10-year CA. The sandbox gets an opaque token (`openrouter-<32 hex>`, 128-bit) set under the REAL env var name; the proxy swaps it for the real credential on the way out, with `require: true` so a request carrying a *real* key instead of the token is REJECTED rather than forwarded. title: Never let a credential reach a log, a transcript, an approval card or an export
contract: `agent/redact.py` (1438 lines) applied to logs, verbose output, tool output, approval prompts, gateway messages, transcripts and memory. 60 vendor prefixes plus env-assignment, dotted/YAML/JSON config keys, Authorization and other secret headers, Telegram tokens, private keys, DB connection strings, JWTs, URL query/userinfo and form bodies. `_REDACT_ENABLED` is snapshotted at import so an LLM-authored `export HERMES_REDACT_SECRETS=false` cannot disable it mid-session. Terminal output picks its aggressiveness from the command shape, sharing the `.env` basename list with the file-read blocker so they cannot drift. Monitoring export scrubs unconditionally with no knob and returns `[redaction-unavailable]` rather than raw text if the redactor cannot run.
governance: read-only transformation, but it must be unconditional on the audit and export paths (no config key may weaken it), mirroring Hermes' monitoring-export rule

contract: Tirith: an external scanner run before every terminal command for homograph/IDN URL spoofing, pipe-to-interpreter shapes and terminal-escape injection. contract: The auth requirement is derived from the bind: loopback gets an ephemeral process-lifetime session token injected into the SPA; ANY non-loopback bind (RFC1918 included — a hostile device on the same LAN is the threat model) engages a full cookie gate, and `--insecure` was made a documented NO-OP rather than removed after the June-2026 campaign.
